title: Librarian Trade Guide
description: Adds a tooltip to enchanted books showing the highest possible level and lowest possible price for each enchantment for trading with Librarians.
body:
Librarian Trade Guide adds a tooltip to Enchanted Books showing what the highest possible level and the lowest possible price is for that Enchantment, which can be useful when trading with Librarian Villagers.

---

Librarian Trade Guide requires the mod Enchantment Descriptions to be installed for it to work.
